subject: Mini pilot — 2-week extension with support trade or credit option
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@averonhealth.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@averonhealth.ai
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mini pilot — request: 2-week extension + discount or equivalent support

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Redwood team helped us validate the integration pattern quickly. We ran another set of calls overnight and hit a couple of throttling edges that slowed our model-selection tests. The current mini-pilot ends next Friday; engineering would like two more weeks to complete acceptance tests.

Budget is tight for this fiscal quarter. Two options would work for us — can you confirm if Redwood can provide either: 

- Option A: A 2-week extension to the pilot at no additional charge + 8 hours of dedicated onboarding / tuning time from your CS engineers; OR
- Option B: A 2-week extension billed at pro-rated rate with a 10-15% discount on the incremental charge (we’d prefer 15% but can be flexible).

We attached a quick metrics dump from the tests (trial_metrics_snapshot.csv) to show current burn and the bottlenecks.

If you can confirm which path you prefer today, we can route procurement to sign a short addendum. Our goal is to complete acceptance by the end of the extension and have a go/no-go decision.

Best,
Priya Desai
Head of ML Ops
Averon Health
[attachment: trial_metrics_snapshot.csv]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@averonhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 18:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mini pilot — request: 2-week extension + discount or equivalent support

Hi Priya — thanks for the note and for sending the metrics. I reviewed the CSV and can see where the prefix cache and sequence-length variance are causing the spikes.

We’re happy to help you finish acceptance. Two practical options we can offer today: 

1) Support-first extension (recommended): 2-week extension at no additional charge + 8 hours of dedicated CS onboarding/tuning (remote; 4x 2-hr sessions). We’ll provide a short SOW addendum that outlines the scope and delivery milestones. This is fast to approve and keeps the customer success assistance focused on the areas your tests highlighted.

2) Discounted add-on: 2-week extension billed pro-rata at our trial rate with a 15% rebate on the extension invoice if you convert to a 12-month committed Dedicated package within 30 days of the pilot end.

If you prefer option 1 we’ll ship an addendum and a small SOW (POC_SOW_v1.pdf attached) for signatures. Option 2 requires a brief finance approval for the conditional rebate (we can get that same day).

Which would you like us to prepare? If you want the support-first path, I’ll loop in Marissa for SOW/sign and Jordan for a quick technical kickoff.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
[attachment: POC_SOW_v1.pdf]

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Averon — ask to commit 8 CS hours + 2-week gratis extension (pending sign)

Marissa / Jordan — quick internal thread to get approvals before I send final addendum to Averon: 

Context: Averon (healthcare) wants a 2-week runway to finish acceptance. They sent trial metrics showing cache churn. I proposed two options; customer prefers Option A (support-first, gratis 2-week extension + 8 hours CS). Procurement will sign a short addendum if we provide the SOW. I attached the SOW I plan to send.

Ask: 
- Marissa: Can finance tolerate a 0-charge extension on a 2-week mini-pilot for a mid-market account if CS time is provided as the concession? We’d treat the 8 hours as an onboarding service (no charge) and expect this to accelerate conversion.
- Jordan: Can you commit a CS engineer for up to 8 hours next week for tuning and two verification sessions? We’ll do two 2-hr deep dives + two 1-hr follow-ups.

If both OK, I’ll send the addendum and set the kickoff. If finance needs a paper trail, we can mark the extension as $0 with a one-line credit memo.

Thanks —
Rachel

Rachel — thanks, that sounds reasonable. Averon would prefer Option A (support-first). A couple of small asks before we sign: 

- Would Redwood consider 6 hours of CS delivered as on-site (or remote overlapping with our engineers) and 2 hours as office-hours for follow-up? Remote is fine, but overlap matters (we have east-coast engineers).
- If finance insists on capturing value, would Redwood accept a 10% goodwill credit on the next invoice instead of marking the extension $0? We’d sign faster with that on the table.

If you can confirm those two minor tweaks I’ll route the addendum and get procurement to sign today. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Priya
